body_lead: Patna (Bihar) [India], February 21 (ANI): United Kingdom's Minister for Artificial Intelligence, Kanishka Narayan, arrived in Bihar his birthplace. On his arrival in Patna he met with Sanjay Kumar Jha, the National Working President of the Janata Dal (United). The visit marks a significant homecoming for the British Minister after more than two decades to observe the state's developmental progress and explore potential technological cooperation. Talking to the media, Kanishka Narayan said, "It's a real pleasure to be here in Bihar.
